sections.title: OH VALLEY/MID-SOUTH/CENTRAL APPALACHIANS
sections.text: DAMAGING WIND/SOME SEVERE HAIL POTENTIAL WILL CONTINUE INTO EARLY EVENING WITH AN MCS ACROSS EASTERN KY/NEARING THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS...AND SPATIAL ADJUSTMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE TO THE SLIGHT RISK ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE REGION. OTHER SEVERE TSTMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP FARTHER WEST ESPECIALLY ACROSS PORTIONS OF INDIANA AND ADJACENT PARTS OF KY/OH. DAMAGING WINDS/SEVERE HAIL REMAIN PRIMARY HAZARDS...BUT A BRIEF TORNADO THREAT MAY EXIST ACROSS AREAS SUCH AS CENTRAL INDIANA IN VICINITY OF OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. REFERENCE MESOSCALE DISCUSSION 1502 AND WATCHES 495/496 FOR ADDITIONAL SHORT-TERM INFORMATION. OTHERWISE...THE SLIGHT RISK WAS ALSO EXPANDED SOUTHWESTWARD ACROSS PORTIONS OF THE MID-SOUTH.

sections.title: ELSEWHERE
sections.text: NO CHANGES...SEE PRIOR DISCUSSION BELOW AND MESOSCALE 1501 REGARDING PORTIONS OF THE DAKOTAS/MN. ..GUYER.. 07/19/2012 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1126 AM CDT THU JUL 19 2012/

sections.title: MID/LWR OH VLY
sections.text: LATEST MESOANALYSIS PLACES A 1012 MB LOW OVER NRN IL WITH A FRONT DRAPED EWD INTO THE NRN MID-ATLANTIC REGION AND WWD INTO KS. THE LOW WILL MOVE TO VCNTY KCVG BY FRIDAY MORNING WHILE THE TRAILING FRONT MOVES INTO THE MID-SOUTH/SRN PLAINS. AIR MASS ALONG/S OF THE FRONT WILL REMAIN VERY MOIST WITH PRECIPITABLE WATER VALUES IN EXCESS OF 1.75 INCHES. MULTI-LAYERED CLOUDS WILL MITIGATE STRONG DESTABILIZATION ACROSS THE UPR OH VLY. BUT...AREAS TO THE SW FROM SWRN OH/IND AND INTO THE MID-SOUTH WILL EXPERIENCE STRONG INSOLATION WITH MLCAPES TO 2500 J/KG. TSTMS ARE EXPECTED TO GRADUALLY INCREASE ALONG BOTH THE FRONT AND RESIDUAL BOUNDARIES TIED TO OUTFLOW AND DIFFERENTIAL HEATING FROM THE MID-OH VLY SWWD INTO SERN MO THIS AFTN. CURRENT BLEND OF VWP AND FCST HODOGRAPHS INDICATE THAT WNW BULK SHEAR WILL REMAIN MODEST AT BEST...AROUND 30 KTS. HOWEVER... GIVEN OVERALL INSTABILITY...MULTICELL STORM CLUSTERS WILL BRIEFLY ORGANIZE INTO FORWARD-PROPAGATING SYSTEMS AND PERHAPS BRIEF SUPERCELLS GIVING DMGG WIND GUSTS AND HAIL. STORMS MAY PERSIST INTO TONIGHT BUT WITH DECREASING SVR THREATS. SMALL MCS OR TWO WILL BE MOST LIKELY VCNTY KY/WV/ERN TN. FARTHER E...SVR THREAT MAY BE A BIT LESS ORGANIZED/MOR

sections.title: NRN PLAINS
sections.text: ELEVATED TSTMS WERE ONGOING LATE THIS MORNING OVER ND/SD AMIDST WEAK LOW/MID-LVL WARM ADVECTION. THESE STORMS MAY PRODUCE SOME HAIL...BUT MAIN CONDITIONAL SVR THREAT WILL EVOLVE THIS AFTN/EVE. ON THE LARGER SCALE...BUILDING HEIGHTS/STRENGTHENING EML WOULD ARGUE AGAINST SFC-BASED TSTM DEVELOPMENT AS PARCELS FAIL TO REACH THEIR LFC/S. HOWEVER...RICH BOUNDARY LAYER MOISTURE AND MAINTENANCE OF CONVERGENCE ALONG THE LEE TROUGH WILL LIKELY BE SUFFICIENT FOR A COUPLE STORMS OVER CNTRL/ERN ND BY LATE THIS AFTN. THIRTY-35 KT 0-8KM SHEAR AND MAGNITUDE OF MID-LVL LAPSE RATES...ON THE ORDER OF 8 DEG C PER KM...WILL BE SUFFICIENT FOR SUPERCELLS AND MULTICELL CLUSTERS GIVING VERY LARGE HAIL AND DMGG WIND GUSTS. A TORNADO OR TWO CANNOT BE RULED OUT IN THE RED RIVER VLY AND ADJACENT ERN ND. OVERNIGHT...A SSE PROPAGATING CLUSTER OF STORMS...WILL CLIP PARTS OF NWRN MN AND NERN SD WITH AT LEAST LOW-END RISKS FOR LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS HIGH WINDS.

sections.title: INTERIOR PAC NW
sections.text: MUCH LIKE YESTERDAY...WDLY SCTD TO LOCALLY SCTD AFTN/EVE TSTMS EXPECTED WITH SFC HEATING IN ZONE OF MODERATE MOISTURE OVER HIGHER TERRAIN IN NE QUADRANT OFF OFFSHORE LOW...FROM THE ORE CASCADES ENE INTO ERN WA/WRN ID. ISOLD SVR HAIL/GUSTS MAY OCCUR. SOME OF THE STORMS MAY PERSIST/REDEVELOP THROUGH EARLY FRI AS UPR LVL DIFLUENCE INCREASES WITH THE NEWD ACCELERATION OF THE OFFSHORE LOW. GIVEN 40-50 KT CLOUD LAYER SHEAR AND CONTINUED NE ADVANCE OF UPR TROUGH...A FEW OF THE STORMS COULD REMAIN LOCALLY STRONG TO SVR.

sections.title: SERN U.S. THIS AFTN
sections.text: SCTD TO LOCALLY NUMEROUS TSTMS IN CLUSTERS AND LOOSELY ORGANIZED BANDS LIKELY WILL FORM AGAIN TODAY OVER MUCH OF THE SERN STATES. AREA SOUNDINGS DO...HOWEVER...APPEAR SOMEWHAT STABILIZED RELATIVE TO YESTERDAY...LIKELY REFLECTING SIZABLE OVERTURNING THAT OCCURRED THERE. AFOREMENTIONED WEAK UPR CIRCULATIONS WILL ONCE AGAIN LARGELY GOVERN WHERE CONVECTION BECOMES MOST CONCENTRATED. A FEW STORMS MAY YIELD LOCALLY DMGG WIND.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG WIND GUSTS MAY CONTINUE TO DEVELOP WITH EVOLVING MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM SPREADING SOUTHWARD ACROSS REGION THROUGH 21-22Z...BUT THIS MAY REMAIN MOSTLY BEFORE SEVERE LEVELS. A WATCH IS NOT CURRENTLY ANTICIPATED...BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: INITIATED BY FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH LOW-LEVEL WARM ADVECTION... STORMS NORTH NORTHEAST OF JACKSON APPEAR TO HAVE GENERATED A FAIRLY SIGNIFICANT SURFACE COLD POOL. COUPLED WITH CONTINUED BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION...LIFT ON ITS LEADING EDGE MAY MAINTAIN VIGOROUS NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT AS LIGHT NORTHWESTERLY DEEP LAYER MEAN FLOW...AND WARM ADVECTION ON WESTERLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW CONTRIBUTE TO A SOUTHEASTWARD AND SOUTHWARD PROPAGATION THROUGH THE CENTRAL APPALACHIANS REGION. FURTHER UPSCALE GROWTH INTO A MORE SUBSTANTIVE MESOSCALE CONVECTIVE SYSTEM DOES NOT APPEAR OUT OF THE QUESTION...WHICH COULD EVENTUALLY BE ACCOMPANIED BY STRENGTHENING WIND GUSTS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE OF THE OUTFLOW. HOWEVER...THREAT FOR GUSTS EXCEEDING 50 KT SEVERE CRITERIA STILL SEEMS LIKELY TO BE MITIGATED BY SOMEWHAT MODEST LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES...LACK OF LARGER SUB CLOUD TEMPERATURE-DEW POINT SPREADS AND THE WEAK NATURE OF THE AMBIENT FLOW FIELD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTIVE COVERAGE WILL INCREASE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...POTENTIALLY EVOLVING INTO A SEWD PROGRESSING MCS CAPABLE OF SIGNIFICANT HAIL AND DMGG WINDS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: EARLIER ELEVATED CONVECTION ACROSS CNTRL ND APPEARS TO HAVE LEFT AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY N OF BIS AND S OF DVL. AREA VAD WIND PROFILE DATA IN THE VICINITY OF THIS BOUNDARY ARE SHOWING IMPLIED WARM ADVECTION...WITH NEW ATTEMPTS AT SURFACE BASED CONVECTION ONGOING. MODIFYING THE 12Z BIS SOUNDING FOR CURRENT SURFACE CONDITIONS INDICATES THAT ANY REMAINING CONVECTIVE INHIBITION WILL VERY SHORTLY BE BREACHED. ADDITIONAL CONVECTION MAY INITIATE ALONG A N-S MOISTURE GRADIENT...CHARACTERIZED BY 100/55 F SURFACE CONDITIONS AT BIS...AND 92/73 F TO THE EAST AT JMS. ALTHOUGH UPPER LEVEL FORCING FOR ASCENT REMAINS WEAK...A SUBTLE WAVE NOTED ON 1845Z WV IMAGERY ACROSS CNTRL/ERN ND AND N CNTRL SD MAY BE SUFFICIENT ENOUGH TO SUPPORT THE EVENTUAL DEVELOPMENT OF AN MCS...GRADUALLY INCREASING IN INTENSITY AMIDST A STEEP LOW-MID LEVEL LAPSE RATE ENVIRONMENT AND STRONG NWLY FLOW ALOFT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TRENDS ARE BEING MONITORED FOR AN INCREASING SEVERE WEATHER THREAT THAT COULD REQUIRE A WATCH AS EARLY AS 21-22Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SIGNIFICANT DESTABILIZATION IS ONGOING NEAR A SURFACE LOW...NOW CENTERED NORTH OF CHAMPAIGN...AND DEVELOPING SOUTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE INDIANAPOLIS AREA. LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES ARE BECOMING RATHER STEEP WITH CONTINUED HEATING...AND OBJECTIVE ANALYSES INDICATE THAT CAPE FOR THE MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER IS INCREASING IN EXCESS OF 2000 J/KG. DEEP LAYER NORTHWESTERLY MEAN FLOW IS GENERALLY WEAK TO MODEST IN STRENGTH...ON THE ORDER OF 20-30 KT...BUT VERTICAL SHEAR MAY BE MARGINALLY SUFFICIENT TO ENHANCE POTENTIAL CONVECTIVE ORGANIZATION...AND PERHAPS SUPPORT AT LEAST SHORT-LIVED UPDRAFT ROTATION. COUPLED WITH THE THERMODYNAMIC PROFILES...THE ENVIRONMENT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE BECOMING INCREASINGLY CONDUCIVE TO SEVERE STORMS. A BRIEF TORNADO MAY NOT BE OUT OF THE QUESTION...BUT THE RISK FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS APPEARS MORE PROMINENT...ALONG WITH SOME HAIL. INHIBITION MAY WEAKEN SUFFICIENTLY FOR STORM DEVELOPMENT WITHIN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS...WHICH SHOULD TEND TO SPREAD EAST SOUTHEASTWARD NEAR A WARM FRONT/REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS CENTRAL INDIANA LATE THIS AFTERNOON.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONVECTION HAS WEAKENED AS STORMS CONTINUE TO TRACK ACROSS HIGHER TERRAIN. MAIN THREAT WILL BE LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS FROM ONGOING CONVECTION OVER THE MCD AREA THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS. A WW IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: BULK OF CONVECTION HAS WEAKENED CONSIDERABLY OVER THE LAST HOUR ACROSS WV WITH A SEGMENT OF STRONGER /BUT SUB-SEVERE/ STORMS CONTINUING OVER ERN PORTIONS OF WW 495 IN WRN VA. WHILE THE AIR MASS WILL REMAIN UNSTABLE FOR AT LEAST A FEW MORE HOURS...DEEP LAYER FLOW IS VERY WEAK OVER THE MCD REGION. ADDITIONALLY...POOR MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES /LESS THAN 6.0 DEG C PER KM/ WILL LEAD TO ANY STRONGER UPDRAFTS BEING SHORT-LIVED. GIVEN THE WEAK SHEAR/POOR MID LEVEL LAPSE RATES THE GREATEST THREAT APPEARS TO BE LOCALIZED STRONG WIND GUSTS DUE TO STEEP LOW LEVEL LAPSE RATES. ANY STORMS PERSISTING INTO THE EVENING HOURS SHOULD HAVE A GENERAL PULSE-TYPE NATURE RESULTING IN MAINLY SUB-SEVERE WIND GUSTS THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED BUT A WW IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME. FORTHCOMING MCD WILL ADDRESS STRONGER STORMS ALONG THE STATIONARY FRONT ACROSS S-CNTRL PA INTO NRN MD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT MAY BE DEVELOPING ACROSS SCNTRL SD AND WRN NEB EARLY THIS EVENING. SEVERE WIND GUSTS AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE WITH THE STRONGER CORES. WW ISSUANCE REMAINS POSSIBLE ESPECIALLY IF THE CELLS CAN CONTINUE TO INCREASE IN INTENSITY OVER THE NEXT 1 TO 2 HOURS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS HAS DEVELOPED SOUTHWEST OF PIERRE SD ALONG THE NRN EDGE OF MODERATE INSTABILITY WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 1000 TO 1500 J/KG RANGE. IN ADDITION...THE WSR-88D VWP AT VALENTINE NEB SHOWS 40 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR SUGGESTING THE STORMS COULD DEVELOP A SEVERE THREAT THAT COULD PERSIST IF THE LINE CAN ORGANIZE FURTHER. DUE TO THE VERY HOT SFC TEMPS ABOVE 100 F ALONG WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 50S F...TEMPS/DEWPOINT SPREADS ARE VERY LARGE SUGGESTING OUTFLOW GUSTS COULD BECOME SEVERE. HAIL MAY ALSO OCCUR BUT MAY BE THE LESSER OF THE TWO THREATS DUE TO THE WARM TEMPS ALOFT AND HOT BOUNDARY LAYER CONDITIONS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO ISOLATED SEVERE WIND GUSTS ARE POSSIBLE WITH STORMS MOVING INTO SE PA/NRN MD THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS. ISOLATED THREAT WILL PRECLUDE A WW ISSUANCE AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STORMS HAVE MAINTAINED ORGANIZATION ALONG STATIONARY BOUNDARY ACROSS SRN PA INTO NRN MD. THESE STORMS ARE IN AN ENVIRONMENT OF MODEST DEEP LAYER SHEAR AROUND 30-35 KT AND WEAK TO MODERATE INSTABILITY. STORMS SHOULD CONTINUE E/SEWD ALONG INSTABILITY GRADIENT INTO VERY MOIST/WARM DOWNSTREAM AIR MASS. STRONG DEEP LAYER FLOW SHOULD ALLOW FOR STORM ORGANIZATION A WHILE LONGER AND AN ATTENDANT THREAT OF STRONG WINDS WILL ACCOMPANY THIS LINE SEGMENT. WEAK MIDLEVEL LAPSE SHOULD LIMIT THE STRENGTH OF STORM UPDRAFTS SO ANY SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO REMAIN SUFFICIENTLY ISOLATED THAT A WW IS NOT EXPECTED AT THIS TIME BUT TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE CHANCE FOR AT LEAST ISOLATED STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS WAS LIKELY INCREASING ACROSS PORTIONS OF NRN/WRN ORE AND SRN WA THROUGH THE EVENING HOURS. WHILE A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED...CURRENT UNCERTAINTY REGARDING OVERALL SEVERE STORM COVERAGE SUGGESTS THAT ISSUANCE IS NOT IMMINENT. CONDITIONS WILL CONTINUE TO BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: MODEST BOUNDARY LAYER DESTABILIZATION HAS OCCURRED WITHIN A REGION WHERE STRONG DAYTIME HEATING HAS ACTED ON RELATIVELY GREATER LOW LEVEL MOISTURE FROM THE WILLAMETTE VALLEY NORTH AND EAST ACROSS THE COLUMBIA RIVER GORGE AND OVER THE COLUMBIA BASIN. WITH SOME AREAS NOW ACHIEVING CONVECTIVE TEMPERATURES AROUND 90F...ISOLATED ROBUST TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED...ESPECIALLY ACROSS NERN ORE. ENTIRE AREA WILL REMAIN UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF A PRONOUNCED MID/UPPER LOW OFF THE COAST THAT WILL LIKELY BEGIN TO ADVANCE ENEWD LATER TONIGHT. MODEST DEEP-LAYER SLY FLOW IN THE ERN FLANK OF THE UPPER LOW WAS RESULTING IN EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDES SUPPORTIVE OF UPDRAFT PERSISTENCE AND ROTATION. IN ADDITION TO HAIL...ANY STRONGER CONVECTION SPREADING ACROSS THE RELATIVELY DEEPLY MIXED BOUNDARY LAYER COULD PRODUCE STRONG TO DAMAGING WINDS. DESPITE GENERALLY FAVORABLE CONDITIONS FOR SEVERE WEATHER...STORM COVERAGE REMAINS SOMEWHAT IN DOUBT. IF GREATER DEVELOPMENT ENSUES IN THE NEXT 1-2 HOURS...A WATCH MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS SOME OF THE REGION. ..CARBIN.. 07/19/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY CONTINUE ACROSS ERN ND AND WILL LIKELY BEGIN TO IMPACT NW MN WITH THE NEXT 1 TO 2 HOURS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A CLUSTER OF STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ONGOING TO THE WEST OF GRAND FORKS IS LOCATED ALONG THE ERN EDGE OF STRONG INSTABILITY WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED IN THE 3500 TO 4500 J/KG RANGE. THE STORMS ARE LIKELY BEING SUPPORTED BY A SUBTLE MID-LEVEL IMPULSE RIDING OVER THE TOP OF AN UPPER-LEVEL RIDGE. IN SPITE OF THE WARM MID-LEVEL TEMPS...THE GRAND FORKS WSR-88D VWP SHOWS ABOUT 35 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR SUGGESTING THE ENVIRONMENT MAY BE SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL. IN ADDITION...STEEP LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND ABOUT 20 KT OF FLOW JUST ABOVE THE BOUNDARY LAYER MAY BE SUFFICIENT FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS. ..BROYLES.. 07/19/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE THREAT WILL CONTINUE MAINLY ACROSS WRN HALF OF WW 495 THE NEXT FEW HOURS. STRONG TO LOCALLY SEVERE WINDS ARE POSSIBLE. STORMS HAVE WEAKENED FURTHER E AND THE WW MAY BE CANCELED NORTH OF ANY ONGOING CONVECTION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTION HAS RECENTLY INTENSIFIED FROM NEAR THE LOUISVILLE METRO AREA SWWD INTO AN AXIS OF GREATER INSTABILITY AHEAD OF SEWD ADVANCING COLD FRONT. THE WW HAS BEEN EXPANDED SWD TO THE TN BORDER IN THIS AREA. WEAK DEEP LAYER FLOW AND MARGINAL MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES SHOULD LIMIT SEVERE THREAT FROM STORMS DEVELOPING IN STRONGER INSTABILITY ACROSS SWRN PORTIONS OF THE LOUISVILLE CWA. THE CONVECTION IMPACTING THE LOUISVILLE AREA MAY POSE A GREATER THREAT AS IT HAS ORGANIZED INTO A LINEAR STRUCTURE AND ANY DEVELOPING COLD POOL WOULD HELP MAINTAIN STORMS AND AID IN STRONG/SEVERE WIND PRODUCTION. BULK OF STORMS/SEVERE THREAT HAS DIMINISHED ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF THE WATCH AREA AND COUNTIES MAY BE DROPPED BY LOCAL WFO/S NORTH OF ONGOING CONVECTION. ..LEITMAN.. 07/19/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE THIS EVENING ACROSS MIDDLE TN. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR CONTINUED STORM ORGANIZATION AS STORMS MOVE INTO N-CNTRL TN FROM SW/S-CNTRL KY. A WW MAY BE NEEDED IN THE NEXT HOUR DEPENDING ON TRENDS. STRONG WIND GUSTS ARE THE MAIN THREAT WITH THESE STORMS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: AREA IS BEING MONITORED FOR POTENTIAL SEVERE WW. STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS MOVING ACROSS SW/S-CNTRL KY SHOULD MOVE INTO N-CNTRL TN IN THE NEXT COUPLE OF HOURS. STRONG INSTABILITY OVER THE REGION /MLCAPE GREATER THAN 2500 J/KG/ SHOULD HELP COMPENSATE FOR RATHER WEAK DEEP LAYER FLOW AND ONLY MARGINAL MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES TO LEAD TO AT LEAST AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT. HOWEVER...IT IS UNCLEAR AT THIS POINT IF STORMS WILL WEAKEN/BECOME INCREASINGLY ELEVATED WITH LOSS OF DAYTIME HEATING. THEREFORE...THREAT COULD BE SHORT-LIVED ACROSS N-CNTRL TN WITH A WEAKENING TREND THEREAFTER OVER MIDDLE TN. THE SAME PHILOSOPHY HOLDS TRUE FOR CONVECTION FURTHER NE NEAR FRANKFORT AND TRENDS WILL NEED TO BE MONITORED FOR CONTINUED ORGANIZATION. A WW MAY BE NEEDED WITHIN THE NEXT HOUR OR SO.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS ARE EXPECTED TO CONTINUE ACROSS E-CNTRL INDIANA INTO W-CNTRL PORTIONS OF OHIO THE NEXT 1-3 HOURS. CONVECTION FURTHER S ALONG THE FRONT WILL STRUGGLE AS STORMS MOVE INTO A WORKED-OVER AIR MASS.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: STRONG TO SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE FOR AT LEAST A FEW MORE HOURS ACROSS E-CNTRL IND INTO FAR W-CNTRL OHIO. THE STRONGEST STORMS ARE EXPECTED ALONG THE INSTABILITY GRADIENT WITH THE CLUSTER NEAR/JUST NE OF INDIANAPOLIS. STORMS WILL CONTINUE EWD INTO STRONGER DEEP LAYER FLOW AND SUPPORTED BY DEEP LAYER ASCENT NOSING INTO THE AREA ASSOCIATED WITH MID-TO-UPPER LEVEL LOW. FURTHER SOUTH ALONG AND EAST OF THE FRONT...AIR MASS HAS BEEN WORKED OVER BY EARLIER CONVECTION /SEE ILN 00Z RAOB/ AND DEEP LAYER ASCENT/STRONGER FLOW WEAKENS CONSIDERABLY. THEREFORE ANY STORMS DEVELOPING/MOVING INTO THIS AREA SHOULD POSE LITTLE SEVERE THREAT. THIS SEEMS TO BE CONFIRMED BY A WEAKENING TREND OF CONVECTION SOUTH OF THE INDIANAPOLIS AREA. ..LEITMAN.. 07/20/2012

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT HAS DIMINISHED ACROSS MOST OF WW 497 EXCEPT NEAR THE CANADA BORDER WHERE HAIL AND DAMAGING WIND GUSTS REMAIN POSSIBLE. DUE TO THE DIMINISHED THREAT...THE WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL CLUSTER OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS IS ONGOING ON THE ND-MANITOBA BORDER LOCATED ALONG AN AXIS OF MODERATE TO STRONG INSTABILITY. THE INSTABILITY COMBINED WITH ABOUT 30 KT OF DEEP LAYER SHEAR MAY RESULT IN A SEVERE THREAT AS THE ACTIVITY MOVES EWD LATE THIS EVENING. HOWEVER...ACROSS THE REST OF WW 497...CONVECTION HAS DIMINISHED AND THE SEVERE THREAT HAS DECREASED FOR NOW. AS A RESULT...THE WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 04Z. SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS MARKEDLY INCREASE LOW-LEVEL FLOW AFTER MIDNIGHT AND REDEVELOP THUNDERSTORM ACTIVITY ON THE NOSE OF THE LOW-LEVEL JET. IF THIS OCCURS...THE STRONG INSTABILITY AND MODERATE DEEP LAYER SHEAR WOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR SEVERE STORMS. IN THIS CASE...WW ISSUANCE COULD AGAIN BE NECESSARY SOMETIME AFTER MIDNIGHT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE CHANCES FOR DAMAGING WIND GUSTS FROM SEVERE TSTMS WILL LIKELY CONTINUE TO DIMINISH ACROSS THE WATCH AREA THROUGH THE REST OF THE LATE EVENING. ADDITIONAL SEVERE TSTM WATCHES ARE NOT ANTICIPATED AT THIS TIME.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: QUASI-LINEAR CONVECTIVE SYSTEM WITH NUMEROUS STRONG TO SEVERE STORMS OVER KY/TN BORDER AREA HAS LIKELY PASSED ITS PEAK INTENSITY OVER THE LAST 1-2 HOURS. HOWEVER...A THREAT FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING DOWNBURST WINDS ACROSS NRN TN MAY EXIST FOR ANOTHER HOUR OR SO...ESPECIALLY NEAR OUTFLOW BOUNDARY INTERSECTIONS WHERE STORM-SCALE DYNAMICS MAY BE LOCALLY ENHANCED AMIDST RESIDUAL STRONG BOUNDARY LAYER INSTABILITY. OVERALL...THE DOWNWARD TREND IN MORE WIDESPREAD SEVERE WIND POTENTIAL IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE GIVEN BOUNDARY LAYER COOLING AND LACK OF STRONGER LARGE SCALE INFLUENCES DRIVING SURFACE BASED STORM DEVELOPMENT AND PERSISTENCE. ADDITIONAL ELEVATED STORMS APPEAR TO BE INCREASING ACROSS THE MCS COLD POOL OVER WRN KY AND NWRN TN. WHILE ISOLATED HAIL/WIND COULD OCCUR WITH THIS MORE RECENT VIGOROUS DEVELOPMENT...HEAVY TO EXCESSIVE RAINFALL MAY BECOME MORE OF A PROBLEM INTO THE NIGHT. A NUMBER OF FACTORS SUPPORT LOCALLY EXTREME CONVECTIVE RAIN ACROSS THIS AREA INCLUDING A DEEP/WARM CLOUD LAYER...VERY SLOW STORM PROPAGATION ...AND THE POTENTIAL FOR BACK-BUILDING CONVECTION AMIDST PW VALUES AROUND 2 INCHES. ..CARBIN.. 07/20/2012
